007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.GenerateAction;
016import java.util.Locale;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for generating a Select AI response with an explicit action.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to call {@link Profile#generate(String, GenerateAction)} with a prompt and generation action.</p>
022 *
023 * <p>To run this sample with prompts such as {@code how many customers}, ensure
024 * the profile object list contains tables that match the prompt. For example,
025 * if the profile object list references the Oracle sample schema objects
026 * {@code SH.CUSTOMERS} and {@code SH.COUNTRIES}, ensure the {@code SH} schema
027 * is installed and visible to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}. The {@code SH} schema
028 * is not guaranteed to exist in every Oracle Autonomous AI Database or Oracle
029 * Database instance.</p>
030 *
031 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROMPT</li>
038 * </ul>
039 *
040 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
041 * <ul>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_GENERATE_ACTION - action name such as {@code showsql}, {@code runsql}, {@code explainsql}, {@code narrate}, {@code chat}, {@code embedding}, or {@code showprompt}. Defaults to {@code showsql}.</li>
043 * </ul>
044 *
045 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
046 * <pre>{@code
047 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
048 * }</pre>
049 *
050 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
051 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
052 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
053 * <pre>{@code
054 * mvn clean install
055 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
056 * }</pre>
057 *
058 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
059 * <pre>{@code
060 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/GenerateProfileSample.java
061 * }</pre>
062 *
063 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
064 * <pre>{@code
065 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.GenerateProfileSample
066 * }</pre>
067 *
068 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
069 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
070 * and diagnostics.</p>
071 */
072public final class GenerateProfileSample {
073    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GenerateProfileSample.class);
074
075    private GenerateProfileSample() {
076    }
077
078    public static void main(String[] args) {
079        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
080        String prompt = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROMPT");
081        GenerateAction action = GenerateAction.valueOf(
082                envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_GENERATE_ACTION", "showsql").trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
083
084        try {
085            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
086            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
087            String response = profile.generate(prompt, action);
088
089            System.out.printf("Generate action '%s' response:%n%s%n", action, valueOrEmpty(response));
090        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
091            LOGGER.error("Failed to generate response for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
092        }
093    }
094
095    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
096        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
097                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
098                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
099                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
100                .build();
101
102        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
103    }
104
105    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
106        String value = System.getenv(name);
107        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
108            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
109        }
110        return value;
111    }
112
113    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
114        String value = System.getenv(name);
115        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
116    }
117
118    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
119        return value == null ? "" : value;
120    }
121
122}
